name.description: the extension's name in the browser's list of extensions and on its toolbar button; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

description.message: Hands downloads from the browser to Mister Download Manager.
description.description: the extension's description in the browser's list of extensions; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

menu.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on a link, picture, video or sound; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_download.description: the button over a video on a web page that downloads it; verb; short (it sits on the video)

video_more.description: the small arrow next to the Download video button that opens its menu (read aloud by screen readers)

video_hide_here.description: menu command of the download button over a video: hide the button on this video only

video_never_site.description: menu command of the download button over a video: never show the button on this web site again

video_settings.description: menu command of the download button over a video: opens its settings in Mister Download Manager

video_sent.description: shown briefly on the download button after it was clicked; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

menu_selected.message: Download selected links with Mister Download Manager
menu_selected.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on selected text: download the links in the selection; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

menu_all.message: Download all links with Mister Download Manager
menu_all.description: command in the browser's right-click menu on a page: download the links of the whole page; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_connected.description: the toolbar button's status when the browser reaches the app; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_connected_version.description: the toolbar button's status when the browser reaches the app, with the app's version number; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_paused.message: Paused: downloads stay with the browser
status_paused.description: status when the user switched off taking downloads in the toolbar button's popup

status_not_installed.message: Mister Download Manager isn't installed, or its browser integration isn't set up
status_not_installed.description: status when the browser can't find the app's connection; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_forbidden.message: Mister Download Manager doesn't accept this copy of the extension
status_forbidden.description: status when the app refuses this copy of the extension (another copy is installed, or it came from another store); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_not_running.message: Mister Download Manager didn't start in time
status_not_running.description: status when the app was started for a download but didn't answer in time; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_host_failed.message: The connection to Mister Download Manager failed
status_host_failed.description: status when the connection to the app broke off (often security software blocking it); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

status_too_large.message: This download's details were too large to hand over
status_too_large.description: status when a download carried too much data (very large cookies) to give to the app

status_update_app.message: Update Mister Download Manager to use everything this extension offers
status_update_app.description: status when the app is older than the extension; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_take.description: check box in the toolbar button's popup: on, downloads go to the app; off, the browser keeps them

popup_proxy.message: Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension
popup_proxy.description: switch in the toolbar button's popup: on, the app downloads through the same proxy the browser uses (one a VPN or proxy extension sets); the browser then asks once to allow reading it

popup_proxy_title.message: Mister Download Manager then downloads through the same proxy as this browser. The browser asks you once to allow it; turning this off takes that back.
popup_proxy_title.description: tooltip of the switch Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_proxy_title_chromium.message: Mister Download Manager then downloads through the same proxy as this browser. While this is off, the extension doesn't read the browser's proxy.
popup_proxy_title_chromium.description: tooltip of the switch Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension in Chrome, Edge and the other Chromium browsers (they ask for no permission at the switch); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_exclude_site.description: switch in the This page tab in the toolbar button's popup: on, this web site's downloads are left to the browser from now on

popup_excluded.message: Downloads from $site$ stay with the browser
popup_excluded.description: shown under the switch Never take downloads from this site in the toolbar button's popup while it is on

popup_open.description: button in the toolbar button's popup; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_options.description: button in the toolbar button's popup: open the app's Options

popup_help.description: link in the toolbar button's popup to the help page

popup_support.description: link at the foot of the toolbar button's popup to the creator's GitHub Sponsors page (MDM is free; this is an optional donation)

popup_fix.description: link under a connection problem in the toolbar button's popup, to the help page's section for it

popup_declined.description: in the toolbar button's popup: the last download the extension let the browser keep instead of handing it to the app; followed by why (one of the declined_* texts)

popup_declined_unnamed.message: The last download was left to the browser.
popup_declined_unnamed.description: in the toolbar button's popup when the last download the browser kept came from a private window (its name isn't kept); followed by why (one of the declined_* texts)

declined_file_type.message: Its type isn't in Options → File types.
declined_file_type.description: why a download stayed with the browser: its file type isn't on the app's list; Options and File types are the app's window and its page, as the app names them

declined_site.message: Its site is in Options → File types, sites left to the browser.
declined_site.description: why a download stayed with the browser: its web site is on the app's list of sites not to take downloads from

declined_address.message: Its address is in Options → File types, addresses left to the browser.
declined_address.description: why a download stayed with the browser: its address matches the app's list of addresses not to take

declined_small.message: It's smaller than the minimum size in Options → File types.
declined_small.description: why a download stayed with the browser: the file is smaller than the app's minimum size setting

declined_browser.message: This browser isn't ticked in Options → General.
declined_browser.description: why a download stayed with the browser: the app's Options don't capture downloads from this browser (its box is unticked in the list of browsers)

declined_integration_off.message: Use advanced browser integration is off in Options → General.
declined_integration_off.description: why a download stayed with the browser: the app's setting 'Use advanced browser integration' is off; keep the setting's name as the app shows it

declined_torrents.message: It's a torrent, and Open magnet links and .torrent files with Mister Download Manager is off in Torrent settings.
declined_torrents.description: why a download stayed with the browser: it is a .torrent file and the app's Torrent settings don't open torrents with Mister Download Manager, so the browser keeps it for the user's own torrent program; keep the setting's name as the app shows it

declined_site_access.message: The extension isn't allowed to read this site (the browser's site access).
declined_site_access.description: why a download stayed with the browser: the user limited the extension's access to web sites in the browser, so it can't pass the sign-in on

popup_alt.message: Hold Alt while clicking a link to let the browser download it.
popup_alt.description: hint in the toolbar button's popup; Alt is the keyboard key

popup_media.description: heading in the toolbar button's popup over the list of the videos, sounds and streams the current web page has loaded

popup_media_none.message: No video or sound found on this page yet. Play it, then open this again.
popup_media_none.description: shown in the toolbar button's popup when the current web page hasn't loaded any video, sound or stream yet

popup_media_streamed.message: This page's player streams its video in pieces, so there's no file to list. Point at the video and use its Download video button.
popup_media_streamed.description: in the toolbar button's popup, when the page's player plays from a stream built in the page (a blob:): the list of the page's media has nothing to show; Download video is the name of the button over videos

popup_media_store.message: The Chrome Web Store's rules keep this copy of the add-on away from this site's videos. Help says what you can do.
popup_media_store.description: in the toolbar button's popup, on a site where the Chrome Web Store's copy of the extension shows no download button; Help is the link at the bottom of the popup

popup_media_download.description: button beside a video, sound or stream in the toolbar button's popup: download it with the app; verb; short

popup_media_protected.description: shown instead of the Download button beside a copy-protected (DRM) stream in the toolbar button's popup: it can't be downloaded; short

popup_media_live.description: beside a stream in the toolbar button's popup: it is a live broadcast (no fixed length); short

video_off.description: on the download button over a video (grey) when the button is turned off on this web site; a 'Turn on' button follows it; short

video_drm.description: on the download button over a copy-protected (DRM) video, which no tool can download; 'can't be saved' follows it after a dot; short

video_unnamed.message: Can't tell which video this is: open its own page and try there
video_unnamed.description: shown briefly on the download button when nothing on the page says which video the player is playing, so nothing was sent

video_looking.description: in the menu that opens from the download button over a video, while the app finds which qualities (resolutions, formats) the video can be downloaded in

video_no_choices.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: the app found no quality of the video it could download

video_playlist.message: A list of videos: choose them in Mister Download Manager
video_playlist.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: the page is a list of videos (a playlist), whose videos are chosen in the app's window; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_no_ytdlp.message: Mister Download Manager needs yt-dlp for this video
video_no_ytdlp.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: the app needs the yt-dlp tool (a program's name, keep it as it is) to find this video's qualities, and it isn't installed; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_too_long.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: the app took more than a minute to find the video's qualities, so the menu stopped waiting

video_busy.message: Mister Download Manager is busy with other videos
video_busy.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: the app is already looking up other videos and can't look this one up now; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_queued.description: shown briefly on the download button over a video after a quality was picked: the download was added to the app's download queue, to start later

video_failed_lookup.description: in the menu under the download button over a video: finding the video's qualities failed; the app's own explanation follows on the next line

video_tab_video.description: tab above the list of qualities in the menu under the download button over a video: the choices that include picture (video with sound); short, one word

video_tab_audio.description: tab above the list of qualities in the menu under the download button over a video: the choices that are sound only (MP3, Opus and the like); short, one word

video_open_post.message: Open the post to download it
video_open_post.description: on the download button (amber) over a video in a feed (a social site's home page, a timeline) that can't be downloaded from there: the user should open the post the video belongs to; short

popup_send_to.description: heading in the toolbar button's popup, above the choice of where downloads go

popup_send_here.description: choice under Send downloads to: the Mister Download Manager on this computer

popup_send_remote.description: choice under Send downloads to: an MDM running on another computer of the network, such as a home server; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_remote_code.description: placeholder of the box for the 8-digit code the other MDM shows

popup_remote_open.description: button: open the other MDM's address in a tab (to accept its certificate once)

popup_remote_pair.description: button: pair this browser with the other MDM using the code

popup_remote_help.message: Open its address once and accept its certificate, then enter a code from its Options, Remote, Pair a device (or misterdownloadmanager-cli pair).
popup_remote_help.description: help under the pairing boxes; Options, Remote and Pair a device are the app's window, tab and button; keep misterdownloadmanager-cli pair as it is

status_remote.description: the toolbar button's status while downloads go to another MDM

remote_address.description: the address typed isn't an https:// address

remote_unreachable.message: Not reached. Open its address once in this browser and accept its certificate, then try again.
remote_unreachable.description: pairing failed: the other MDM didn't answer

remote_wrong_code.description: pairing failed: the code was wrong

remote_no_code.message: It shows no code now: click Pair a device there first.
remote_no_code.description: pairing failed: the other MDM shows no pairing code; Pair a device is its button

remote_too_soon.message: Wait a moment, then try again.
remote_too_soon.description: pairing failed: codes tried too fast

remote_device_name.description: the name this browser gets in the other MDM's list of paired devices

popup_media_title_name.message: Prefix media file names with the page title
popup_media_title_name.description: Option in the browser extension media list: put the page title before the original file name when downloading a detected media file

video_cant_save.description: on the download button over a copy-protected video, after 'Protected video ·': it can't be downloaded; short, lower case

video_open_post_button.description: button on the download button over a video in a feed: opens the post the video belongs to in a new tab; verb; very short

video_drag_dots.message: Drag the dots to move it along the edge
video_drag_dots.description: second line of the tooltip of the download button over a video: dragging its dotted grip moves it along the video's edge

video_tip.description: first line of the tooltip of the download button over a video: what one click downloads; $what$ is a quality, a file type and a size, e.g. '1080p MP4 · 412 MB'

video_tip_best.description: first line of the tooltip of the download button over a video while the app is still finding its qualities

video_sending.description: on the download button over a video right after it was clicked, while the download goes to the app; MDM is Mister Download Manager's short name, keep it as it is; short

video_added.description: on the download button (green) over a video after the app added and started the download; a quality may follow ('· 1080p') and a 'Show' button; MDM is the app's short name, keep it; short

video_show.description: button on the download button over a video after a download was added: shows that download in the app's window; verb; very short

video_no_answer.description: on the download button (red) over a video when the app isn't installed or didn't start; 'Get MDM' and 'Retry' buttons follow; MDM is the app's short name, keep it; short

video_get_mdm.description: button on the download button over a video when the app didn't answer: opens the app's download page; MDM is the app's short name, keep it; very short

video_retry.description: button on the download button over a video when the app didn't answer: try again; verb; very short

video_turn_on.description: button on the download button over a video when it is off on this web site: turns it on again here; verb; very short

video_best.description: after the best quality in the menu of the download button over a video, after a star (★ best); lower case; one word

video_all_qualities.description: command in the menu of the download button over a video: opens the app's Download video window, with every quality and the subtitles

video_failed.message: Mister Download Manager isn't installed or didn't start
video_failed.description: shown briefly on the download button when the app could not be reached; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

video_download_best.description: first line of the list under the download button over a video: downloads the best quality at once; the quality, its file type and size follow on the same line; short

video_original.description: in the list under the download button over a video, after a sound-only line's bitrate: the sound as the site sends it, not converted (e.g. '128 kbps · original'); lower case; one word

video_compatible.description: in the list under the download button over a video, after a quality's height (1080p): the H.264 video with AAC sound in an MP4, the file that plays in every video editor, TV and phone; short, about 20 characters at most

popup_video_hide_fullscreen.message: Hide the download button in full screen
popup_video_hide_fullscreen.description: Option in the toolbar button's popup: while a web page is in full screen, the Download video button over its videos stays hidden

popup_video_hide_fullscreen_title.message: While the page is in full screen, its videos show no Download video button
popup_video_hide_fullscreen_title.description: Tooltip of the Hide the download button in full screen option in the toolbar button's popup; Download video is the name of the button over videos

popup_gear.description: the gear button at the top of in the toolbar button's popup: opens Mister Download Manager's Options window; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_tabs.description: name of the row of tabs in the toolbar button's popup, read by screen readers

popup_tab_downloads.description: tab in the toolbar button's popup: the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads; noun, short

popup_tab_page.description: tab in the toolbar button's popup: what can be done on the web page open in the browser (its videos, leaving its site to the browser); short

popup_tab_settings.description: tab in the toolbar button's popup: the extension's settings; noun, short

popup_conn.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: the browser reaches the app; its version follows; short

popup_conn_plain.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: the browser reaches the app; short

popup_conn_off.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: the browser can't reach the app (why is said below it); short

popup_conn_paused.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: taking downloads from this browser is paused; short

popup_conn_update.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: the app is older than the extension; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is; short

popup_conn_remote.description: under the extension's name in the toolbar button's popup: downloads go to another Mister Download Manager, a server, at this address; short

popup_cancel.description: button of a question in the toolbar button's popup: don't do it

popup_page_none.message: This isn't a web page: there's nothing to do here.
popup_page_none.description: in the This page tab in the toolbar button's popup when the browser's tab shows one of its own pages (settings, a new tab)

popup_exclude_by_rule.message: Left to the browser by a rule in Options
popup_exclude_by_rule.description: in the This page tab in the toolbar button's popup, under the switch Never take downloads from this site, when a pattern in Mister Download Manager's Options excludes the site (the switch can't be turned off here)

popup_dl_search.description: placeholder of the search box in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads); it finds downloads by their name or address

popup_dl_filters.description: name of the row of filters in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) (All, Running, Done, Failed), read by screen readers; verb

popup_dl_all.description: filter in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): every download; short

popup_dl_running.description: filter in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): the downloads downloading now; short

popup_dl_done_filter.description: filter in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): the finished downloads; short

popup_dl_failed_filter.description: filter in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): the downloads that failed; short

popup_dl_clear.description: button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): takes the finished downloads off the list (their files stay); short

popup_dl_running_count.description: tooltip of the number on the Downloads tab in the toolbar button's popup: how many downloads are running

popup_dl_remote.message: These are the downloads of the Mister Download Manager at $server$. Open their files there.
popup_dl_remote.description: note at the top of the list in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when downloads go to another Mister Download Manager (a server): the buttons that need the file on this computer are not offered; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_dl_more.message: The newest $shown$ of $total$. Mister Download Manager lists them all.
popup_dl_more.description: under the list in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when there are more downloads than it shows; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_dl_of.description: a running download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): how much has come of its size

popup_dl_left.description: a running download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): the time left, as a clock (minutes:seconds)

popup_dl_starting.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when it has just started and nothing has come yet

popup_dl_paused.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): stopped by the user, can be resumed; short

popup_dl_waiting.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): waiting in a queue, never started; short

popup_dl_done.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): it has just finished; short

popup_dl_just_now.description: a finished download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): it finished less than a minute ago; lower case where the language allows

popup_dl_failed.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): it failed; short

popup_dl_failed_why.description: a download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): it failed, and why (the app's words)

popup_dl_gone.description: a finished download's line in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when its file is no longer where it was saved

popup_dl_loading.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads), while it asks the app for them

popup_dl_none.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app has no downloads

popup_dl_none_text.message: What you download with Mister Download Manager shows up here.
popup_dl_none_text.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app has no downloads; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_dl_no_match.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when no download matches the search or the filter

popup_dl_no_match_text.message: No download's name or address has “$words$”.
popup_dl_no_match_text.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when no download matches the search; the words searched for follow

popup_dl_show_all.description: button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): clears the search and the filter

popup_list_off.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app isn't running; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_off_text.message: Start it to see your downloads here.
popup_list_off_text.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app isn't running

popup_list_start.description: button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app isn't running; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_old.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app is too old to list its downloads here; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_old_text.message: This version can't list its downloads here yet.
popup_list_old_text.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app is too old to list its downloads here

popup_list_busy.message: Mister Download Manager is busy. Trying again...
popup_list_busy.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app didn't answer in time; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_unreached.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the browser can't reach the app (why is said below it); keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_remote_unreachable.message: Can't reach the Mister Download Manager at $server$
popup_list_remote_unreachable.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the other Mister Download Manager (a server) doesn't answer; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_list_remote_unreachable_text.message: Check that it's running, and that this browser accepts its certificate (Settings → Send downloads to → Open it).
popup_list_remote_unreachable_text.description: in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the other Mister Download Manager (a server) doesn't answer; Settings, Send downloads to and Open it are the names of a tab, a section and a button of the popup

popup_act_open.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): opens the downloaded file; verb

popup_act_open_named.description: screen readers' name of a finished download's name in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): clicking it opens the file

popup_act_folder.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): opens the file's folder with the file selected

popup_act_folder_named.description: screen readers' name of a download's Show in folder button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads)

popup_act_copy_file.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): puts the file itself on the clipboard, to paste it into a folder, a chat or a message

popup_act_share.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): opens the system's share sheet for the file

popup_act_copy_link.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): copies the download's address

popup_act_pause.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): stops a running download, to resume it later; verb

popup_act_pause_named.description: screen readers' name of a running download's Pause button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads)

popup_act_resume.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): goes on with a paused, waiting or failed download; verb

popup_act_resume_named.description: screen readers' name of a download's Resume button in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads)

popup_act_again.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): downloads the file again from the start

popup_act_remove.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): takes the download off the list, its file stays

popup_act_delete.description: command in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): takes the download off the list and deletes its file from the disk (it asks first)

popup_act_more.description: tooltip of the ⋯ button of a download in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): opens its menu

popup_act_more_named.description: screen readers' name of the ⋯ button of a download in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads)

popup_ask_delete_title.description: title of the question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) before a download's file is deleted

popup_ask_delete.message: $file$ will be deleted from your computer, and the download taken off the list. This can't be undone.
popup_ask_delete.description: question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) before a download's file is deleted

popup_ask_delete_ok.description: button of the question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): deletes the file; verb

popup_ask_clear_title.description: title of the question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) before the finished downloads are taken off the list

popup_ask_clear.message: The $count$ finished downloads go off the list. Their files stay where they are.
popup_ask_clear.description: question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) before the finished downloads are taken off the list

popup_ask_clear_ok.description: button of the question in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads): takes the finished downloads off the list; verb

popup_said_file.message: Copied $file$. Paste it into a folder, a chat or a message.
popup_said_file.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Copy file

popup_said_link.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Copy link

popup_said_removed.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Remove from list

popup_said_deleted.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Delete file

popup_said_again.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Download again

popup_said_cleared.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) after Clear finished

popup_act_gone.message: That download is no longer in the list.
popup_act_gone.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when a button's download was removed meanwhile

popup_act_missing.message: Its file is no longer where it was saved (moved or deleted).
popup_act_missing.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when a download's file can't be opened, copied or shared

popup_act_running.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when a running download can't be removed or downloaded again

popup_act_cant.message: That can't be done to this download now.
popup_act_cant.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when a button can't act on the download

popup_act_unsupported.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the system has no way to do it

popup_act_off.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app isn't running; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_act_busy.message: Mister Download Manager didn't answer in time. Try again.
popup_act_busy.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when the app didn't answer in time; keep the name Mister Download Manager as it is

popup_act_failed.description: said briefly in the Downloads tab of the toolbar button's popup (the list of Mister Download Manager's newest downloads) when a button's action failed

status_running.description: second line of the toolbar button's tooltip while the app downloads: how many downloads are running

popup_dl_open_remote.description: button at the foot of the Downloads tab in the toolbar button's popup when downloads go to another Mister Download Manager (a server): opens that server's own web page
